item.title: Incarico post-doc: Migration routes: agency, materiality and solidarity. A multisensorial approach. (Univ. PARMA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-10 23:59
Institution: Univ. PARMA, Parma
Field: Political and social sciences / 14/GSPS-06 Sociologia dei processi culturali e comunicativi

DEBMAT asks: how can we understand the structuring of migration routes beyond the present moment? The project addresses this through an innovative lens, examining the materiality of transit and its constitutive effect on the (re)production of migration routes, investigating the structures, infrastructures, and actors shaping routes across the Mediterranean at large. Through material ethnography, material interviews, and Counter-Archiving Workshops, DEBMAT explores the social cartography of migration routes, develops methodologies bridging contemporary archaeology with multi-sited ethnography, and reshapes public discourse on transit migration through collaborative archiving with field…

item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-03 12:00
Institution: Univ. BOLOGNA, Bologna
Field: Political and social sciences / 14/GSPS-05 Sociologia generale

Title of the project:" The Historic City Centre in Transition: New Populations, Urban Practices, and Socio-Spatial Inequalities ". The research activity will focus on the design, implementation and analysis of a multidimensional study investigating the representations, perceptions and patterns of use of Bologna’s historic center, in support of the Integrated Strategy promoted by the Municipality of Bologna.
